title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech | TechCrunch
summary: But Helix believes its technology isn’t yet capable of reliably detecting AI agents during live calls. Siri co-founder Kittlaus said that voice identification technology has finally reached a point where it works reliably, positioning Helix to scale as AI-powered fraud increases.
